evals.prompt: I am adding MAD/Source/MADNewThing.m to the MAD framework. It uses only NSDate and NSUUID, with no UIKit. Walk me through making it compile on Linux and Windows, and tell me what to run.
evals.expected_output: Adds the file to both source inventories, runs the parity checker, confirms the file is portable, mentions the test port and registration, and orders a fast per-target compile before the full Linux gate at PR time.

evals.prompt: MADNewThing.m compiles on macOS but the Linux image fails with 'MADNewThing.h: no such file or directory', even though the header is in the same directory. What should I check?
evals.expected_output: Checks case-exact imports, self-contained header imports, source-inventory membership, and any unguarded UIKit/AppKit dependency; suggests the one-line translation-unit check and the fast per-target compile.
